remarks: "Discover a piece of Darien's history with this charming 1880 Colonial Farmhouse w/covered front porch" Nestled in the heart of Darien, this cherished family home "fixer upper" offers a unique opportunity to revitalize a home filled with years of loving memories, to make it your very own. This 3 bedroom, 2 bath home offers an open concept floor plan... highlighted by 2 wood-burning fireplaces, hardwood floors, & exposed ceiling beams. The partially finished walk-up attic, adds loads of potential for additional living space. Ideally located... this property is in very close proximity to schools, library, the beach, & Darien center... which offers easy access to various shopping options and variety of eateries. Bonus of Metro North Train and major highways only minutes away, making for an easy commute. While the property requires several updates and repairs, it offers an incredible opportunity to revive and customize. "Come make this house your home!"
